items.question: What is the ultimate cause of the sacred letters?
premises: The cause of letters is requested
items.inference: The origin of the letters is sought from Śiva.
items.plain_english: O world-adored, trident-handed one, speak the cause of the letters.

items.question: Why should a normally secret teaching be disclosed to the goddess?
premises: The teaching is not to be revealed
items.inference: Affection overrides the usual secrecy of the teaching.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, this should not be revealed! Yet out of affection for you, O sweet-speaking one, I will speak.

items.question: How should the goddess receive the essential teaching being offered?
premises: The teaching is to be heard
It should be heard in its essence
The goddess is addressed as proud in great youth
items.inference: The goddess is instructed to hear the teaching in its true essence.
items.plain_english: Hear that in its essence, O you who are proud in great youth.

items.question: What condition is necessary for attaining success in this teaching?
premises: Knowledge of these letters is required

items.inference: Success cannot arise without knowledge of the letters.
items.plain_english: O Vāme, O guru-breasted one, without knowledge of these there would be no success.
